newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE WILL NOT TAKE PART IN NATO EXERCISE SEPT 22.
newsitem.headline: GREECE WILL NOT TAKE PART IN NATO EXERCISE SEPT 22.

text.p: Greece will not take part in NATO's Dynamic Mix 96 exercise from September 22 to October 10 which will take place in the area under the alliance's southern sector command, the defence ministry said on Friday.

The decision by Defence Minister Gerassimos Arsenis was based on Greece's policy since 1985 not to join in alliance activities which do not meet conditions set by Greece, a defence ministry statement said.
It gave no further details. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
